package.description: A free and open-source peer-to-peer file sharing client

en-US.description: A free and open-source peer-to-peer file sharing client
en-US.longDescription: eMule is a free and open-source peer-to-peer file sharing client, allowing you to connect to millions of users to download and share files with them. By using the ED2K and Kademlia Network it supports semi-centralized as well as decentralized searches and operations. All of it free and without any adware or advertising.
en-US.name: eMule

zh-CN.description: 免费开源的点对点文件共享客户端
zh-CN.longDescription: eMule 是一款免费开源的点对点文件共享客户端，让您连接到数百万用户并与他们下载和共享文件。支持通过 ED2K 和 Kademlia 网络进行半中心化和去中心化的搜索和操作。所有这些都是免费的，没有任何广告或广告软件。
zh-CN.name: eMule
